design.additional_book_omission: Retain at least three other books; report minimum and maximum probability, never treat these as confidence intervals
design.final_reference: Last same-book fresh quote 15-90 minutes before saved card start, after decision; at least three other books for independent probability
design.longshot_definition: selected American moneyline at least +300; descriptive only
no_go: No production adoption based on this sample
No assumption that all recorded sportsbooks are accessible
design.power_selection_time: chosen for this diagnostic after prior aggregate results were known; not a prospective or untouched evaluation
questions: Do recorded selected prices retain positive estimated return when sportsbook margin removal changes?
Does excluding any one additional comparison book erase the entry-price advantage?
Do selections beat fresh final same-book prices and independent other-book probabilities?
How do unadjusted market, frozen calibrated market, and winner-model probabilities compare on the same post-calibration-freeze fights?
design.same_fight_comparison: Main locked decisions issued after calibration artifact creation; each method scores the same fighter orientation, fight and excluded target book
design.selected_bets: Existing immutable main moneyline and market-first selections only; preserve their respective thresholds and show them separately
design.single_margin_alternative: power: choose k so implied_fighter^k + implied_opponent^k = 1; average adjusted probabilities across non-target books

interpretation: Selected-price sensitivity on already observed outcomes. Policies are separate, not additive. Book-omission ranges are not confidence intervals.
